Northwich Market hits major milestone within weeks of opening

24th November
Leisure
Northwich
By Jack Tooth Chief Reporter

Share

13 comments
The market has had positive reviews (Image: Cheshire West and Chester Council)
This article is brought to you by our exclusive subscriber partnership with our sister title USA Today, and has been written by our American colleagues. It does not necessarily reflect the view of The Herald.
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:15
Instaread

NORTHWICH Market has hit a major milestone of 100,000 visitors within weeks of opening in the town centre.

The market has had positive reviews while the market

traders
have had promising returns since mid-September.

As of late November it has hit a major milestone of 100,000 visitors to the location according to the local authority.

There is a mix of food and drink stalls and non-food and drink stalls at a site fresh from a move from Weaver Square.

Claire Forster of The Style Hut (Image: Cheshire West and Chester Council)

Claire Forster, the owner of The Style Hut, said: "I am delighted with how well the first few weeks have gone."

Danny Cole, the owner of The Chicken Hatch, said: "The past 10 weeks have flown by - it has been so thrilling."

Northwich Market has a packed schedule up until the new year including a shot at a £25 voucher, a £50 voucher or a £100 voucher simply for spending with one of the market traders.

It will have a Christmas Prize Draw for two weeks from Wednesday, December 2; a Twilight Market on Thursday, December 3; and a Christmas Jumper Day on Thursday, December 10.

Danny Cole of The Chicken Hatch (Image: Cheshire West and Chester Council)

Nathan Pardoe, Cheshire West and Chester Council's cabinet member for regeneration, said: "Congratulations to the market traders and to Cheshire West and Chester Council's market team for reaching this milestone."

These are the food and drink stalls:

  • Bean & Cole
  • Casa de Sal Bar
  • Habib's Shawarma
  • Loco 4 Tacos
  • Spuds 4 U
  • Sweet Northwich
  • Thai by Thai
  • The Chicken Hatch

These are the non-food and drink stalls:

  • Beauty Wow
  • Betty Lemon
  • Candy Bay
  • E Phones
  • Hide & Hands
  • oneministore
  • Pop Specs
  • RetroFits
  • Steve's Cheese
  • The Style Hut
  • Thimblewick Gifts

Northwich Market is open five days a week from 9am to 5pm on Wednesday and Thursday, from 9am to 10pm on Friday and Saturday, and from 10am to 5pm on Sunday.

Furthermore it is open for an extra few hours until 9pm in the build-up to Christmas Day on Thursday, December 3; Thursday, December 10; and Thursday, December 17.

Northwich Market is at Weaver Point Way, Northwich, CW9 5FT.

For information on Northwich Market go to www.northwich.market.
